# FAQ

\*\*\* First draft \*\*\*

**Where is the toolbox hosted?** For now, Bluesquare hosts it in the cloud under the Gates Foundation grant, at no cost to programmes. Hosting in country will be decided country by country. It is easier where OpenHEXA and IASO are already deployed nationally.

**What does it cost a programme?** Nothing, as long as the toolbox is hosted by Bluesquare during the current project. Setting up an account, running the pipelines and using SNT Explorer come at no cost. The Bluesquare team can also help configure the account.

**Can we use our own data and analyses?** Yes. Upload them as layers in SNT Explorer, with or without the OpenHEXA pipelines.

**Do we need to code?** No. Programme officers use menus in OpenHEXA and SNT Explorer. Analysts can go further with AI assistants or their own R scripts.

**How do we start?** There are two options:

- Set up your own demo account in SNT Explorer at [demo.snt-toolbox.org](https://demo.snt-toolbox.org/snt_malaria/public/setupAccount), using a GeoJSON file of your country's administrative boundaries.
- Contact Bluesquare via [snt-toolbox.org](https://www.snt-toolbox.org) for a production account, or to get started with OpenHEXA.
